description: A fast reaction game: gray smoke puffs pop up at random spots and the player must tap each one before it expires to 'sound the alarm' and clear it. Tapped puffs flash green ALARM!; missed puffs raise the DANGER meter, and spawn speed plus danger pressure ramp up each round. Game ends when the danger meter fills.
fireSafetyLesson: When you see smoke, tell a grown-up and get out fast. Working smoke alarms save lives — test yours every month!
title: Fire Alarm Frenzy

description: A Simon-style rhythm/sequence game with three big touch pads (STOP / DROP / ROLL). A cute fire baby demonstrates the sequence by standing, crouching, and spinning as pads light up with tones, then the player taps the pads back in the same order. Each round adds one more move; one wrong tap ends the game.
fireSafetyLesson: If your clothes catch fire: STOP where you are, DROP to the ground, and ROLL to put the flames out!
title: Stop Drop Roll

description: A simplified falling-block puzzle on an 8-wide x 14-tall grid. Flame-colored ember tetrominoes fall and the player slides, spins, and hard-drops them via on-screen touch buttons or arrow keys. Filled rows melt away for points with escalating speed per level; the game ends when blocks stack to the top.
fireSafetyLesson: Keep matches and lighters away from kids — they're tools, not toys. Only grown-ups should use them.
title: Ember Tetris

description: A kid-friendly tower defense. Wild flame enemies march along a winding dirt path toward the Fire Baby village (cute houses + cheering fire babies). Tap glowing grass spots to place water towers (30 coins each); towers spray water droplets at flames in range, splashes earn coins, and flames that reach the village cost a life. 10 waves — victory screen if all cleared, game over if lives hit 0.
fireSafetyLesson: Water puts out most fires. Know where your home's fire extinguisher is — remember PASS: Pull, Aim, Squeeze, Sweep!
title: Blaze Defender

description: A pressure-free creative dress-up game with a cute fire baby center stage. Four category tabs (Hats, Glasses, Neck, Shoes) each offer 4-6 canvas-drawn options — party hat, firefighter helmet, crown, sunglasses, star glasses, bowtie, cape, sneakers, roller skates, and more — all FREE, nothing locked. Tapping an option dresses the baby; Surprise Me randomizes; Save Outfit increments the outfits-saved counter with a happy star-burst animation.
fireSafetyLesson: Wear snug-fitting clothes near heat — loose sleeves can catch fire. Dress smart, stay safe!
title: Fire Baby Dress-Up

description: An endless lava surfer. A fire baby rides a surfboard over flowing lava waves with a volcano silhouette and glowing streaks; tap/click or press Space to jump over rocks and glowing gaps. Speed ramps up with distance; floating stars give +25 bonus points and +5 per passed obstacle. Game over on hitting a rock or falling in a gap — the baby safely hops off the board smiling, never harmed. Score = distance + star bonuses.
fireSafetyLesson: Lava is fun in games — but in real life, stay away from stoves, ovens, and anything hot!
title: Lava Surfing

description: Guide a fire baby explorer (in a cute safari hat) through a cave maze using the on-screen arrow pad, swipe, or arrow keys/WASD. Collect every glowing crystal to clear the level while dodging drifting smoke clouds — touching one costs a heart (the baby just coughs and keeps smiling). 3 lives, endless levels with more crystals and faster smoke each round; score = crystals collected.
fireSafetyLesson: If you're in a smoky room, stay LOW — clean air is near the floor. Crawl under the smoke!
title: Crystal Cave Explorer

description: A fire baby firefighter holds an extinguisher at the bottom of the screen — touch and hold anywhere to aim and spray a water cone toward your finger. Wild flames pop up at random spots; flames caught in the spray shrink and poof out with a happy 'POOF!', while ignored flames grow bigger. 60-second timer; score = flames extinguished.
fireSafetyLesson: Aim a fire extinguisher at the BASE of the flames, not the top. Remember PASS: Pull, Aim, Squeeze, Sweep!
title: Fire Extinguisher Aim

description: Top-down racing: drive a little fire truck (driven by a smiling fire baby) around an oval track with auto-acceleration — steer with the on-screen left/right buttons or arrow keys. Complete 3 laps as fast as possible; cones and oil slicks only slow you down with a funny BONK/SPLAT, nobody gets hurt. Game-over screen shows total time, best lap, and per-lap times.
fireSafetyLesson: In a real fire, never use elevators — take the stairs! Have a family escape plan and practice it twice a year!
title: Blaze Racer

description: A 2048-style merge puzzle on a 4x4 grid where cute ember faces evolve from Spark to Phoenix. Swipe on touch screens or use arrow keys/WASD to slide tiles; matching embers merge into the next bigger, happier stage with a pop and sparkle burst. Game ends when the grid fills with no moves left, with a special celebration if the player reaches Phoenix.
fireSafetyLesson: Small embers can become big fires! Always fully put out campfires — drown it, stir it, and feel for heat.
title: Ember Evolution

description: A kid-friendly quiz with 10 multiple-choice fire-safety questions (911, Stop Drop and Roll, smoke alarms, crawling under smoke, family meeting spots, and more), shown one at a time with 3 big tappable answer buttons. Correct answers earn a fire baby cheer and a point; wrong answers gently reveal the right answer. Questions and answer order shuffle each play; the results screen shows the score out of 10 with a 0-3 star rating and encourages replay.
fireSafetyLesson: Knowing what to do in a fire keeps you and your family safe — share what you learned today with a grown-up!
title: Fire Safety Quiz
